svg.title: SonyEdge responsive application screens
svg.desc: Browse, selection, preview, imports and settings screens with compact and expanded responsive variants.

g.text: A calm, camera-first workflow that keeps originals, progress and recovery visible.
COMPACT 320 DP · PHONE 390 DP · EXPANDED 600 DP
Original JPEG and RAW from camera storage
Swipe to browse · Double tap 2.5x · Pinch 1-5x
Completed originals remain available in Android Gallery.
Original JPEG, ARW and supported video files
Discovery, DMS requests and download logs
Labels stay on one line; all targets remain 48 dp.
Three columns preserve readable card widths.
Preview metadata may sit beside the image.
Content never stretches to fill width without constraints.
The implementation follows the same state model as the current camera protocol and download service.
Auto-open may traverse Camera to PhotoRoot to the latest Date while each request ID remains cancellable.
Android Back: close preview, clear selection, Browse destination, then previous camera folder.
The visible page changes immediately; camera data may continue loading progressively.
Crossfade the resolved image without clearing the previous bitmap or flashing the background.
Failure remains in the queue with Retry. Cancel stops only the active service work.
All saved originals surface through Android MediaStore and Open gallery.
Progress and recovery stay visible when the camera disconnects.
Saved endpoint, DMS pagination, folder cache, request cancellation and timeout diagnostics remain unchanged.
Stable IDs, thumbnail cache, JPEG/RAW labels, preview pager, EXIF orientation, zoom and batch selection remain unchanged.
Queue, progress, cancel, failed retry, file validation and DCIM / Sony Picture MediaStore output remain unchanged.
Connection tools, cache controls, base URL details and logs remain available without dominating the primary gallery.
